title: 第17章 泼天的富贵第18章 战斗英雄
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
今天苏灿坐车去了光明公社的桃村，这对姜玉容一家来说，简直就是件天大的喜事。
陆战东之前通过关係，给杨家买了自行车，缝纫机和手錶，再加上之前的两百块彩礼，加起来也不少钱了。
就算是给了苏灿三百，杨家也是赚了的。
昨天苏灿一走，姜玉容便赶紧带上亲生女儿杨雅丽去了自己不错的姐妹家。
这个姐妹叫何秀，年纪轻轻已经成了县城一中的副校长。
最重要的，不是她这个职务，而是她的公公是个退下来的老首长。
何秀最近一直跟姜玉容说，老首长有个不错的手下，这次在反击战中立了大功，已经被提拔为副师长了。就是到现在为止都没有结婚。
老首长一直惦记著这个部下，希望何秀能帮忙介绍个不错的对象。
她觉得杨雅丽各方面的条件都不错，家教好再加上容貌也不错，要是这门亲事成了，那杨雅丽便直接成了副师长夫人了。
这跟那个残废的陆战东比起来，这门婚事可是好了不止一个等级。
简直就是泼天的富贵呀。
去拜访人家，自然少不了拿东西。
姜玉容早就准备好了，把苏灿一送走，赶紧带著女儿直奔何秀家。
何秀跟姜玉容的关係好，还有一个原因，那就是她们两家多少是沾亲带故的。
两人向来都是以表姐妹相称，姜玉容比何秀小了几岁，所以叫她表姐。
何秀早就提前跟公公打过招呼了，听说今天来的女孩子是给自己最得力的部下介绍的对象，萧老首长非常的开心。
看到杨雅丽时，言谈举止文雅端庄，大方得体。
再加上这个家庭的情况也不错，姜玉容是纺织厂的车间主任，她的丈夫杨得志在政府机关里工作。
这样的家庭让萧老首长非常的满意。
何秀把母女俩送出了军区大院，一路上都笑的合不拢嘴。

“玉容，这婚事百分之百准了。不过我公公还得打个电话把人家约过来，我估计还得再待个几天吧，雅丽就能跟那个副师长见面了。”
更新不易，记得分享101看书网
姜玉容有点担忧：“表姐，那个副师长不会已经有自己的对象了吧？”
她现在別的不怕，就怕这个。
万一那个副师长自己找了个年轻满意的姑娘处对象，那女儿这婚事就有些悬了。
“你把心放到肚子里吧，那个副师长几个月前我可是见过的，人长的又俊又有能力。那时候老首长就跟他提过，他说全权委託给我公公做决定了。所以只要我公公看上了，这婚事百分百是没跑的。”
姜玉容听的顿时乐的合不拢嘴了：“哎哟，那可真是太好了。表姐，这事要是成了，我一辈子都记著你的好！你可就是我们家雅丽的恩人了。”
何秀笑著道：“这话不就说远了吗？咱们可是一家人，一家人就不说两家话，你说是不是？”
“对对对！表姐，那你快回去吧，我们到时候等你电话。”
“好。”
姜玉容带著女儿回家的路上，母女俩高兴的不行。
姜玉容还特意买了些好吃的，今天晚上全家人说什么也得好好乐一乐。
content_en:
Today, Su Can took a car to Taocun, Guangming Commune. This was a huge happy event for Jiang Yurong's family.
Through his connections, Lu Zhandong bought bicycles, sewing machines and watches for the Yang family. Together with the previous gift of 200 yuan, it added up to a lot of money.
Even if they gave Su Can three hundred, the Yang family would still make a profit.
As soon as Su Can left yesterday, Jiang Yurong quickly took her biological daughter Yang Yali to her nice sister's house.
This sister's name is He Xiu, and she has become the vice principal of the county's No. 1 Middle School at a young age.
The most important thing is not her position, but that her father-in-law is an old retired chief.
He Xiu has been telling Jiang Yurong recently that the old chief has a good subordinate who has made great contributions in the counterattack this time and has been promoted to deputy division commander. I just haven't gotten married yet.
The old chief had been thinking about this subordinate and hoped that He Xiu could help introduce a good candidate.
She felt that Yang Yali had good conditions in all aspects. She had a good tutor and good looks. If the marriage was successful, Yang Yali would directly become the wife of the deputy teacher.
Compared with the crippled Lu Zhandong, this marriage is much better.
It's simply overwhelming wealth.
When visiting someone’s home, it’s natural to pick up something.
Jiang Yurong had already prepared, sent Su Can away, and quickly took her daughter straight to He Xiu's house.
Another reason why He Xiu and Jiang Yurong have a good relationship is that their two families are more or less related.
The two have always known each other as cousins. Jiang Yurong is a few years younger than He Xiu, so he calls her cousin.
He Xiu had already greeted his father-in-law in advance. He heard that the girl who came today was the one to be introduced to his most capable subordinate. Chief Xiao was very happy.
When I saw Yang Yali, her speech and behavior were elegant, dignified, generous and decent.
In addition, the family's situation is also good. Jiang Yurong is the workshop director of a textile factory, and her husband Yang Dezhi works in a government agency.
Such a family makes Chief Xiao very satisfied.
He Xiu sent the mother and daughter out of the military compound, smiling from ear to ear along the way.
"Yurong, this marriage is 100% certain. But my father-in-law still has to make a phone call to invite her over. I guess I have to stay for a few more days so that Yali can meet the deputy teacher."
It’s not easy to update, remember to share with 101 Kanshu.com
Jiang Yurong was a little worried: "Cousin, doesn't that deputy division commander already have a partner of his own?"
She is not afraid of anything else but this.
If the deputy division commander finds a young and satisfied girl to be his partner, then his daughter's marriage will be in doubt.
"Just keep your heart in your stomach. I met the deputy division commander a few months ago. He was handsome and capable. The old chief mentioned it to him at that time, and he said that he had given full authority to make the decision to my father-in-law. So as long as my father-in-law is interested, this marriage is 100% guaranteed."
Jiang Yurong was so happy that she couldn't help but smile from ear to ear: "Oh, that's great. Cousin, if this happens, I will remember your goodness for the rest of my life! You will be our Yali's benefactor."
He Xiu smiled and said: "Isn't this a far-fetched statement? We are one family, and one family does not talk about two families, don't you think?"
"Yes, yes! Cousin, go back quickly. We will wait for your call then."
"Okay."
On the way Jiang Yurong took her daughter home, the mother and daughter were extremely happy.
Jiang Yurong also specially bought some delicious food. The whole family must have a good time tonight no matter what.
